name: Telescope Zoom Scroll
description: Pinned full-screen scroll scene where a heading splits apart, small images fly toward the viewer in 3D, and a blurred background image zooms in and sharpens as you scroll.
contents: Pinned full-screen section with back image and masked front image
Two-part heading that splits left and right
Ten small floating images positioned around the screen
behavior: Section pins and scrubs with scroll through GSAP ScrollTrigger
Small images travel forward in 3D perspective with a center-out stagger
Front image scales up and unblurs while the background layer scales in
Heading halves slide apart as progress increases
editableByProps: Both background images, small images and their positions
Heading text, size, color and font family
Scroll range, easing, durations, stagger, blur and scale values
Background color and front image mask

needsCodeEdit.where: translate3d calc expressions on the two heading spans

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the 3D depth of small images
needsCodeEdit.where: perspective style on the small images container

fixed: Pins the section and ties it to page scroll via ScrollTrigger, so scroll length equals the section height after the pin
Heading is a single line with two halves and the split distance is fixed at 66vw
